title: AuthFlowSession
description: A locally captured browser auth-flow observation session. Contains request metadata only — never raw header values, cookie values, tokens, or bodies.

session_id.description: Operator-assigned or generated UUID for this recording session.

target_label.description: Operator-supplied free-text label for the engagement target. Must not contain secrets.

url.description: Full request URL. Query strings are retained; operators should scrub tokens embedded in query params before export/sharing.

type.description: Resource type as reported by the browser (xmlhttprequest, main_frame, sub_frame, etc.).

auth_header_names.description: Names only (e.g. 'authorization', 'cookie', 'x-csrf-token') of request/response headers that matched an auth-related name pattern. Values are never captured.

set_cookie_names.description: Names only of cookies set in Set-Cookie response headers, if observable. Values are never captured.
